paraphrased_document_findings: The core contains multiple clock domains and separate reset regions.
The board/example reset is synchronized to the relevant core clock domain. In GT configuration the guide identifies independent_clock_bufg for this synchronization.
local_implementation_check: Existing GbEPcsPma reset helper asynchronously asserts a four-stage pipeline and releases it on independent_clock200MHz. New top-level control feeds this existing public interface. Native TX/RX startup FSM functional HDL unchanged.
limits: Document crosscheck does not determine the initiating physical fault or prove vendor startup instructions universally wrong.
No additional minimum-width specification is inferred from this reset-domain page. No short-pulse variant was built or programmed in this crosscheck.
Claims about the actual built image still require source, DCP, timing, full readback and boot tests recorded separately.
